steps.headline: The money page now has the Home page's look, brackets for negative amounts, a bank mark on every row and links out.
steps.changed: Raised rounded cards with a soft glow, a pill row along the top, net worth beside its chart, warnings as glowing tiles, coloured marks for each bank, and thicker limit bars. Negatives read ($35,329). Every account and bill has a button that opens that company's site.
steps.notice: The page reads like part of the app's newer pages. To pay a bill, press the arrow on its row and the company's site opens in your browser.
steps.risk: Bank marks are letters in each company's colour, not their real logos, which a page cannot load without asking. The links open each company's main site, not the exact payment screen.

steps.path: Pages, then Money (in the practice app)
steps.headline: Try it again: open Pages, then Money. Press a bill's arrow, change a range on the chart, and update a loan.
steps.notice: This is the practice app: nothing you change is saved and the banks are pretend. In the practice app a link may open nothing; in the real app it opens your browser.

steps.path: The page buttons along the top of the window, and the Pages list
steps.headline: The money page gets its own banknote icon, so it no longer looks like the analytics page.
steps.changed: A ninth page icon, a banknote with a coin, that any page can pick. Your wider ask — the page builder choosing a distinct icon for every page from a much bigger set — is on the roadmap as its own piece of work.
steps.notice: Along the top of the window, Money and YouCoded analytics no longer share a bar chart.
